targets.label: measurement_before_intervention
targets.description: While the player is producing decision evidence, prior record-derived readings and engine insight must not be exposed; feedback becomes available only after the evidence-producing phase ends.

targets.label: one_primary_action
targets.description: Each interaction state should present one primary action, with any escape/navigation lower-weight; duplicate or competing primary actions violate the product loop.

targets.label: mode_as_permission_contract
targets.description: Interaction state/mode centrally determines permissions such as whether prior evidence may be shown, whether the engine may speak, and whether the player is producing evidence; screens should not independently invent these permissions.

targets.label: central_next_action_and_none
targets.description: The next action is derived centrally from product/record state and what is missing; screens render that answer rather than independently deciding. Waiting or no recommendation is a valid first-class outcome.

targets.label: explicit_board_authority
targets.description: Board interaction authority is explicitly derived by stage/mode; selection, targets, clicks or drags are disabled when authority is none, and undeclared authority is not silently accepted.

targets.label: persisted_record_source_of_truth
targets.description: Screens should read the persisted record rather than rely on their own local assembled copy for durable product truth across navigation or later rendering.

targets.label: blind_unknown_is_explicit
targets.description: Missing inputs/context are represented explicitly as blind or unknown so disagreement caused by unavailable information is not conflated with a wrong decision/recommendation.

targets.label: record_missing_not_inferred_weakness
targets.description: Action selection is justified by what the record is missing, not by inferred player weakness or personalized measurements that would change exposure and contaminate later evidence.
